newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon-Satolas air cargo traffic up 8.7 pct Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Lyon-Satolas air cargo traffic up 8.7 pct Jan-Sept.

text.p: Airfreight traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas airport in the first nine months of the year totalled 15,475 tonnes, up 8.7 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.
United Parcel Service of America Inc, DHL Worldwide Express and TNT Express Worldwide each operate air cargo services at Lyon-Satolas.
UPS recently launched feeder flights between Lyon and three other French cities - Bordeaux, Toulouse and Nice - last month, using two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.

January-September 1996 postal traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas totalled 10,024 tonnes, up 0.4 percent on the first nine months of last year. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax_44 171 542 5017
